effects.before: No public complete small-tree nofollow replay of the legacy recipe-zero package content hash against an exact source witness.
effects.after: Public helper replays the frozen legacy0 hash from a bounded complete file census and exact package pin, with root/bytes recheck; it does not grant arbitrary-tree or hostile-writer CAS claims.
effects.platform: Selected GNU/Linux bounded fixture proof; native macOS/Windows unrun.

effects.before: No public named factory limited to one witnessed exact local registry slot and offline source choice.
effects.after: Public factory pins local registry/source roots and package witness and refuses network/global/embedded fallback; the separate orchestrator wrapper still owns post-fetch cache-byte attestation.
effects.audience: Rust library consumer / internal install owner
effects.platform: Source-declared local-only route with selected GNU/Linux tests; native macOS/Windows unrun.

effects.before: The public package-tree witness had no public comparison against a fetched copy of its exact selected content.
effects.after: PackageTreeWitness::validate_copy_content and the public attest_package_tree_copy helper compare the bounded complete selected-file set and digest against a copied tree; a detected mismatch is not a no-effects claim after fetch.
effects.audience: Rust library consumer / internal install owner
effects.platform: Selected GNU/Linux bounded fixture tests; native macOS/Windows and hostile-writer atomicity unproved.

effects.before: The public PackageSource trait had no final read-only source/cache check hook immediately before install apply.
effects.after: A public default no-op recheck_before_apply hook is invoked before slot/lock/boot writes; protected sources may override it with bounded owner validation, while existing ordinary implementations retain their prior behavior.
effects.audience: Rust library consumer / install source implementer
effects.platform: Public trait method compiled for Linux/macOS/Windows; selected GNU/Linux protected fixture proof only.

effects.before: The protected one-package fixture could use a fetched cache copy before comparing all bounded source rows and rechecking immediately before apply.
effects.after: Internal wrapper attests the returned cache copy and rechecks it before slot/lock/boot apply; a mismatch after fetch is uncertain partial, not a no-effect preflight refusal. No general machine Install adapter is exposed.
effects.platform: Selected GNU/Linux fixture proof; cache effects before post-fetch check and native Mac/Win remain outside.

user_impact.reason: Additive public bounded legacy0 hash, PinnedLocalFactory, package-tree copy attestation and PackageSource pre-apply hook Rust APIs; ordinary source defaults remain unchanged and no 1.0.x user-owned state is converted.

documentation_impact.reason: Document exact local-only factory/hash and copied-tree attestation contracts, the public PackageSource pre-apply hook, post-fetch uncertainty and bounded source/copy checks; final source-page mapping and native portability proof pending.
